description: Main source file implementing the Flutter front-end of a grocery shopping app. Contains app initialization, theme setup, main screens, bottom navigation, product cards, banners, and UI components.

classes.name: GroceryApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp with theme, routes, and initial screen.

classes.name: GroceryHomeScreen
classes.description: Main home screen of the app displaying greetings, search, banners, recommended products, categories, and bottom navigation.

classes.name: PlaceholderScreen
classes.description: Simple placeholder pages for routes like favorites, categories, cart, etc.

classes.name: _Badge
classes.description: Badge widget displaying cart item count.

classes.name: _CircleIconDot
classes.description: Small circular decoration used as icon indicator.

classes.name: _LabelValueChevron
classes.description: UI component showing label, value, and a chevron icon.

classes.name: _BannerCard
classes.description: Component for promotional banner with emblem and text overlay.

classes.name: _ProductCard
classes.description: UI card representing individual product with image, title, subtitle, price, and add button.

classes.name: _PriceBadge
classes.description: Displays price and unit badge for product.

classes.name: _AddButton
classes.description: Add to cart button with plus icon and press animation.

classes.name: _CategoryChip
classes.description: UI chip representing a product category.

classes.name: _BottomNav
classes.description: Custom bottom navigation bar with navigation buttons and decorative notch.

classes.name: _NavHome
classes.description: Specialized widget for the 'Home' button, styled as a diamond.

classes.name: _NavItem
classes.description: Generic widget for other navigation items with icon and label.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initial entry point that runs the GroceryApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method of GroceryApp that creates the MaterialApp with theme, routes, and home screen.

methods.name: _GroceryHomeScreenState.build
methods.description: Constructs the main scrolling UI with header, search, banners, products, categories, and bottom navigation.

methods.name: _onAdd
methods.description: Handler to simulate adding a product to cart, updating badge count.
